title: Four walks cannot find the Shadow entry in the Effects list
goal: Four scripted runs stop because they cannot reach the tick, or the colour, on the Shadow entry of the Effects list: the app answers that no such thing is there. Until that is sorted nobody can prove by machine that turning an effect off and on, or dropping a colour on one, still works.
acceptance: Whatever the cause turns out to be, no walk step was weakened or deleted to make it pass

log.note: Triage 2026-09-08: ran the walks myself on a probe built from HEAD (Scripts/playtest-all.sh, 12 passed, 0 failed, 2m 25s). parts-settings-inline-walk 8s ok, parts-off-is-remembered-walk 15s ok, switch-says-mixed-walk 8s ok, colour-onto-an-off-part-walk 10s ok. Fixed by find-out-why-thirteen-scripted-walks-are-failing: the four walks were stale after Shadow moved into the Effects list, and the harness gained a way to name an effect's colour swatch by the effect.
